name: Key Vault
summary: Key Vault for secrets, keys and certificates with Azure RBAC, purge protection and private access only.
useWhen: You need to store secrets, keys or certificates
You need customer-managed keys or Key Vault references for app settings
avoidWhen: You only need app configuration values that are not secret (use App Configuration)
You need a dedicated single-tenant HSM (use Managed HSM)
